items.title: Ritual – Tweed Regional Museum
items.summary: Free exhibition exploring the everyday rituals and traditions of Tweed communities, through 21 November.
items.body: Ritual at Tweed Regional Museum explores traditions, seasons and everyday practices that connect communities. The free exhibition opened 29 July 2026 and continues through 21 November 2026.

items.title: Beach Life: Nicholas Harding
items.summary: Major touring exhibition exploring Nicholas Harding's connection to New South Wales coastal landscapes and beach culture.
items.body: Tweed Regional Gallery is presenting Beach Life: Nicholas Harding from 28 August to 22 November 2026. Drawn from the Nicholas Harding Estate, the exhibition includes oil paintings, ink works and watercolours focused on coastal landscapes and beach life.

items.title: Pan Pacific Masters Games 2026
items.summary: Multi-sport masters competition and social program across the Gold Coast from 6 to 15 November.
items.body: City of Gold Coast's official What's On calendar lists the Pan Pacific Masters Games starting 6 November 2026 with nine additional dates, through 15 November. Events take place across the Gold Coast, with Broadbeach listed as the event locality. Check the official listing for sport-specific venues and schedules.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Viva La Salsa at Miami Marketta
items.summary: Free monthly salsa social at Miami Marketta on Thursday 12 November.
items.body: Miami Marketta's official November schedule lists Viva La Salsa, a free monthly salsa social, for Thursday 12 November. The listing does not specify start or finish times.

items.title: Bangalow Show 2026
items.summary: Two-day agricultural show with livestock competitions, local produce and family activities at Bangalow Showgrounds.
items.body: The Bangalow Show takes place on 13–14 November 2026 at Bangalow Showgrounds, Market Street. The community show features agricultural competitions, pavilion exhibits, local produce and family entertainment.

items.title: Murwillumbah After Dark
items.summary: Upcoming Murwillumbah evening event listed by the Tweed's official tourism authority for Friday 13 November.
items.body: Visit The Tweed lists Murwillumbah After Dark for Friday 13 November 2026. Further program and start-time details were not independently confirmed; check the official tourism listing before travelling.

items.title: ABBA Thank You for the Music at Byron Theatre
items.summary: ABBA tribute concert at Byron Theatre on Friday 13 November, 7:30–9:50pm.
items.body: A ticketed two-hour tribute show celebrating ABBA's songs and story takes place at Byron Theatre, 69 Jonson Street, Byron Bay, on Friday 13 November 2026 from 7:30pm to 9:50pm.

items.title: Kingscliff Lions Beachside Markets
items.summary: Beachside community market at Jack Bayliss Park on Saturday 14 November, 8am–1pm.
items.body: The published Tweed Coast market calendar lists Kingscliff Lions Beachside Markets for the second Saturday of November at Jack Bayliss Park, Marine Parade, Kingscliff. Stalls include local artists, designers, jewellery and food producers; the listed hours are 8am–1pm.
items.source_name: The Beach Cabarita / Tweed Coast events guide

items.title: Cherry Pickers Market
items.summary: Vintage fashion market with coffee, vinyl DJs and street food on Saturday 14 November.
items.body: The venue confirms Cherry Pickers Market on Saturday 14 November, opening from 9am, with vintage fashion, coffee, vinyl DJs and street food. Free entry; closing time not specified.

items.title: Byron Twilight Market
items.summary: Local arts, crafts, food and live music at Railway Park on Saturday 14 November, 4–9pm.
items.body: The Byron Twilight Market brings local makers, designers and musicians to Railway Park in Byron Bay on Saturday 14 November 2026, from 4pm to 9pm. The market is part of a seasonal Saturday series.

items.title: Pottsville Beach Markets
items.summary: Sunday community market at Philip Street Reserve, 7am–1pm.
items.body: The Tweed Coast events guide lists the Pottsville Beach Markets for Sunday 15 November 2026 at Philip Street Reserve. The market includes produce, plants, local art and community stalls, from 7am to 1pm.
items.source_name: The Beach Cabarita / Tweed Coast events guide

items.title: The Coastal Markets – Broadbeach
items.summary: Beachfront artisan market at Kurrawa Park with handmade goods, fashion, gifts, homewares and coastal-inspired finds.
items.body: The City of Gold Coast event listing confirms The Coastal Markets at Kurrawa Park, Broadbeach, on Sunday 15 November 2026 from 8am to 2pm. The free beachfront market brings together handmade and artisan vendors in a coastal setting.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Bright Lights Awards 2026
items.summary: Local screen talent celebrated at Byron Theatre on Sunday 15 November.
items.body: Bright Lights Awards celebrates local screen talent at Byron Theatre, Byron Bay, on Sunday 15 November 2026 from 7pm. Tickets are required.

items.title: All Day I Dream of Australia – Byron Bay
items.summary: Melodic electronic music at the beachfront Beach Hotel on Friday 20 November.
items.body: All Day I Dream of Australia is scheduled at the Beach Hotel in Byron Bay on Friday 20 November 2026 from 6pm. Ticketed event; confirm lineup and ticket availability with the venue.

items.title: Kingscliff Triathlon
items.summary: Coastal triathlon weekend in Kingscliff with kids, sprint and Olympic-distance racing centred on Cudgen Creek and the foreshore.
items.body: AusTriathlon and the event organiser confirm the Kingscliff Triathlon for 21–22 November 2026. Saturday includes check-in and transition activities, with racing on Sunday 22 November from Cudgen Creek and the Kingscliff foreshore. The November Olympic event is a World Triathlon Age Group Qualifier for the Standard Distance.

items.title: Byron Wellness Festival 2026
items.summary: Three-day Byron Bay wellness festival with live music, yoga, breathwork, sound healing and workshops, 27–29 November.
items.body: Byron Magazine's November events calendar lists Byron Wellness Festival from Friday 27 November at 10am through Sunday 29 November at 10pm. The program is described as three days of live music, yoga, breathwork, sound healing and workshops in Byron Bay.

items.title: Peter Garrett & the Alter Egos
items.summary: Peter Garrett and the Alter Egos play a Friday evening pub show at Hotel Brunswick.
items.body: Moshtix confirms Peter Garrett & the Alter Egos at Hotel Brunswick on Friday 27 November 2026 from 6pm. The Brunswick Heads show is one of a small run of pub performances announced ahead of the Queenscliff Music Festival and is an 18+ event.

items.title: Tweed Regional Gallery summer exhibition opening
items.summary: Free summer exhibition opening celebrations at Tweed Regional Gallery on Friday 27 November, 6–8pm.
items.body: Tweed Regional Gallery will host free summer exhibition opening celebrations on Friday 27 November 2026 from 6pm to 8pm, featuring Beautiful Tensions: Gray Street Workshop celebrates forty years, The Drink by Brendan Kelly, and Attend the Weather by Kinza Larmor. Bookings are essential.

items.title: Movies Under the Stars: The Polar Express
items.summary: Free outdoor family movie night at Lionel Perry Park in Surfers Paradise.
items.body: Experience Gold Coast lists a free Movies Under the Stars screening of The Polar Express at Lionel Perry Park, Surfers Paradise, on Saturday 28 November 2026. Doors open at 6pm and the movie is scheduled for 7pm.

items.title: Carols by the Coast 2026
items.summary: Kingscliff's Carols by the Coast is listed for Friday 11 December in Tweed Shire Council's supported events program.
items.body: Tweed Shire Council's 2026–27 events sponsorship allocation confirms Carols by the Coast for 11 December 2026. The council listing confirms the date and support allocation but does not provide a verified start time; check the organiser for further program details.

items.title: Mini Marketeers at HOTA
items.summary: A free market showcasing young entrepreneurs and their creative stalls at HOTA.
items.body: HOTA confirms Mini Marketeers on Sunday 20 December 2026 from 9am to noon at the Entrance Terrace, 135 Bundall Road. Parents must accompany participating children; stallholder registration is required.

items.locality: Miami / Mermaid Beach / Surfers Paradise / Main Beach
items.title: Gold Coast reports 1.2 million cubic metres of sand restored to beaches
items.summary: City reports major 2026 offshore dredging works replenished beaches from Miami to Main Beach.
items.body: In an 8 October 2026 update, City of Gold Coast said offshore dredging between April and October had returned approximately 1.2 million cubic metres of sand to Gold Coast beaches, including Miami, Mermaid Beach, Surfers Paradise and Main Beach. The work was part of recovery and beach nourishment efforts following Tropical Cyclone Alfred.

items.title: Gold Coast considers trial of night surfing lights at Snapper Rocks
items.summary: Gold Coast councillors are considering a proposal to trial artificial beach lighting during the 2027 World Surf League Championship Tour at Snapper Rocks.
items.body: ABC Gold Coast reported on 2 November 2026 that councillors would consider a proposal to trial artificial lighting at beaches to extend surfing time, with the recommended trial linked to the 2027 World Surf League Championship Tour at Snapper Rocks. The report also records an environmental scientist's warning that night lighting could attract prey species and potentially affect shark activity.

items.title: Byron Farmers Market
items.summary: Thursday morning produce market at Butler Street Reserve, 7–11am.
items.body: Byron Farmers Market is listed for Thursday 12 November 2026, 7am to 11am at Butler Street Reserve, offering seasonal produce and locally grown food.

items.title: Burleigh Market
items.summary: Community farmers and makers market in Burleigh Heads on Saturday 14 November.
items.body: City of Gold Coast's official events calendar lists Burleigh Market on Saturday 14 November 2026. The community market features farmers' produce, arts, crafts, plants, coffee and local musicians. Exact opening and closing hours were not confirmed in the consulted listing.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Marine Expo
items.summary: Marine lifestyle and boating exhibition in Hollywell on 14–15 November.
items.body: City of Gold Coast's official events calendar lists a family-friendly Marine Expo in Hollywell starting Saturday 14 November 2026 and continuing the following day, featuring boats, marine businesses and marine attractions. Daily hours were not verified.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: The Coastal Markets – Coolangatta
items.summary: Beachfront artisan market at Queen Elizabeth Park on Sunday 22 November, 8am–2pm.
items.body: The Coastal Markets return to Queen Elizabeth Park, Marine Parade, Coolangatta, on Sunday 22 November 2026 from 8am to 2pm. Free-entry beachfront market featuring handmade goods, design, fashion, gifts and local makers.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Mini Museum Explorers
items.summary: Free family storytelling and craft session at Tweed Regional Museum, Friday 13 November, 10–10:30am.
items.body: Tweed Regional Museum hosts Mini Museum Explorers on Friday 13 November 2026, 10am to 10:30am. The free session combines stories, songs, crafts and role play for children aged three and over with carers. No booking required.

items.title: The Coastal Markets – Burleigh Heads
items.summary: Beachfront artisan market scheduled for Sunday 29 November from 8am.
items.body: The Coastal Markets are scheduled for Burleigh Heads on Sunday 29 November 2026 from 8am. The official Gold Coast events listing describes handmade and artisan stalls at the beachfront market; the closing time was not independently confirmed.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: The Spit North beach access remains closed due to erosion
items.summary: City of Gold Coast lists The Spit North beach as closed until further notice due to erosion and unstable sand scarps.
items.body: The official City of Gold Coast beach information page reports The Spit North closed until further notice after severe erosion and sand scarps associated with Tropical Cyclone Alfred and seasonal high tides. This is an erosion-related beach access closure, not a shark alert. Check council notices before visiting.

items.title: Movies Under the Stars – Minions & Monsters
items.summary: Free outdoor cinema at Palm Beach Parklands on 21 November, with activities from 5pm and screening at 7pm.
items.body: City of Gold Coast lists free family activities, face painting and food trucks from 5pm at Palm Beach Parklands, 945 Gold Coast Highway. The film starts at 7pm; the listed event concludes at 9pm. Check the organiser's updates for weather changes.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Broadwater Christmas Twilight
items.summary: Waterfront festive market and live music at Broadwater Parklands, Saturday 12 December, 3–9pm.
items.body: The Great Lawn at Broadwater Parklands hosts the free Broadwater Christmas Twilight event, with artisan stalls, food, live holiday music, children's activities and Santa. City of Gold Coast lists 3pm–9pm on 12 December.
items.source_name: What's On Gold Coast / City of Gold Coast

items.title: Byron Community Market – December
items.summary: Byron's monthly community market is scheduled for Sunday 6 December at Main Beach Foreshore.
items.body: Byron Shire Council's event calendar lists the Byron Community Market for Sunday 6 December 2026, 8am–2pm, at Main Beach Foreshore, Bay Street, Byron Bay. The foreshore is the listed temporary market location during drainage works.

shark_alerts.title: Multiple sharks sighted near swimmers at Greenmount
shark_alerts.detail: Greenmount Beach was closed twice after up to five sharks were sighted near swimmers. This is the latest verified notification currently stored for Greenmount Beach; it is historical, not a current beach closure.
shark_alerts.source_name: Courier Mail / Gold Coast shark sighting report

shark_alerts.title: Surfer knocked from board by shark at Cabarita
shark_alerts.detail: Matthew Devine was knocked from his board by a shark at Cabarita Beach around 4pm and returned to shore without a shark-bite injury. He suspected a bull shark, but the species was not confirmed. This is the latest verified notification currently stored for Cabarita Beach; it is historical, not a current alert.

shark_alerts.title: Tagged bull shark detected at Clarkes Beach
shark_alerts.detail: Tagged bull shark #3362 was detected by the Clarkes Beach, Byron Bay listening station at 3:03:12am AEDT on 31 October 2026. The timestamp is stored here in Australia/Brisbane time. This is a historical tagged-shark detection, not a current beach closure.
